evals.name: create-business-view
evals.prompt: In an isolated copy of evals/files/project/, initialize a git repository with main as its only branch and commit the supplied fixture evidence. Create a business roadmap for Request workspace from its accepted direction and current evidence.
evals.expected_output: Creates a business-facing view preserving the online-intake pilot as next and monthly reporting later. Online intake remains incomplete because client notifications moved to an unfinished successor. Records tested storage separately from unverified deployment and pilot outcomes. Does not invent deadlines or redefine a stopped quality experiment as successful.
assertions: The next accepted result is the online-intake pilot, with monthly reporting later and legacy imports excluded
Online intake maps to both FEAT-001 and FEAT-002, with client notification still incomplete despite the checked transfer task
Storage acceptance is distinguished from live availability and pilot success
The stopped answer-quality experiment retains an unmet target and does not become a pilot blocker
No new dates, priority changes, task writes, or external calls occur

evals.name: refresh-preserves-course
evals.prompt: In an isolated copy of evals/files/project/, place existing-roadmap.md at docs/roadmap.md. Initialize a git repository with main as its only branch and commit the supplied fixture evidence. Refresh the project roadmap.
evals.expected_output: Corrects the stale completed online-intake row, follows the successor obligation, preserves capability names/order and the explicit pilot exclusion, and records the verification scope. Does not turn the rejected reporting-first suggestion into accepted direction.
assertions: Online intake no longer claims complete while receipt notifications remain undone
Both original capability names and their accepted ordering survive
The pilot excludes legacy imports sentence survives unchanged in meaning
The transfer to FEAT-002 is visible in the source mapping and remaining outcome
Monthly reporting is not promoted to the next result

evals.name: github-source-unavailable
evals.prompt: In an isolated copy of evals/files/project/, place existing-roadmap.md at docs/roadmap.md. For this case set tracker.mode to github with github_repository example/request-workspace, add spec_issue 42 to FEAT-002, and map its task to issue 43. Initialize a git repository with main as its only branch and commit this fixture evidence. Refresh the roadmap. Those issues cannot be accessed in this run; do not contact a remote service.
evals.expected_output: Reports that current GitHub status cannot be verified and keeps the affected capability unverified, without using local checkboxes as GitHub completion authority. Preserves accepted direction and records exactly what was not checked.
assertions: No GitHub completion state is inferred from the local FEAT-002 checkbox
Current notification progress is marked unavailable or unverified with the inaccessible issue source named
No current deployment or outcome success is claimed
No credentials, network, configuration migration, or service launch is attempted by the skill

evals.name: absent-automatic-target
evals.prompt: In an isolated copy of evals/files/project/, initialize a git repository with main as its only branch and commit the supplied fixture evidence. A Foreman assignment requests a roadmap refresh. No docs/roadmap.md exists. Return the producer report.
evals.expected_output: Returns a Roadmap report with Artifact none — roadmap absent and Status: done. Creates no business document or new configuration and does not select delivery work.
assertions: No docs/roadmap.md is created
The producer report ends Status: done and identifies the absent target
No product brief, task state, configuration, or delivery selection changes

evals.name: tracked-publication-preserves-review-target
evals.prompt: In an isolated fixture copy, put existing-roadmap.md at docs/roadmap.md and commit all fixture evidence on main. Create a task branch and commit a work-note file; this exact task head is the current code-review target. Foreman requests a roadmap refresh from main plus the attributed observation that notification work has started on that task head. Prepare the update and return the Roadmap report. No remote publication is requested.
evals.expected_output: Prepares and commits only docs/roadmap.md on a separate documentation branch and isolated worktree, preserving the canonical checkout, task head, and main. Reports exact candidate and publication pending, attributes in-progress work without claiming completion, and leaves source contracts untouched.
assertions: The canonical task branch, its exact reviewed head, working-tree state, and main ref are unchanged
The candidate commit exists on a distinct documentation branch and its complete diff against main contains only docs/roadmap.md
The report identifies the exact candidate path, branch, commit, base, and pending publication without claiming the published roadmap was refreshed
Notification work may be underway at the supplied task head but is not complete; the accepted pilot-first course is retained
No push, PR, merge into the integration branch, configuration edit, or delivery-state mutation occurs

evals.name: pending-candidate-refresh
evals.prompt: In an isolated fixture, start from the tracked-publication-preserves-review-target setup and retain its prepared candidate and exact Roadmap report. Land new acceptance evidence for receipt notifications on main, with availability and pilot use still unchecked. Foreman requests another refresh using the new main revision and prior Roadmap report. Prepare the current view and return the report. No remote publication is requested.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the exact pending candidate, merges the new integration base without rewriting its history, and updates the same documentation branch. The resulting diff against the new base remains roadmap-only. Reports implemented intake while leaving availability and pilot outcomes unverified, and keeps the canonical task review target unchanged.
assertions: The prior candidate remains an ancestor of the new candidate on the same attributed documentation branch
The new integration base is included and the complete diff against it contains only docs/roadmap.md
Online intake reflects accepted notification completion without claiming release availability or pilot success
Canonical task branch and reviewed head are unchanged; the report remains publication pending
